example_sv: Ministern var tvungen att avgå efter skandalen i pressen.
example_en: The minister had to resign after the scandal in the press.

example_en: We visited his grave in the cemetery every anniversary.

example_sv: Har du hunnit läsa igenom dagens agenda inför mötet?
example_en: Have you had time to read through today's agenda for the meeting?

example_sv: Han är en aktiv medlem i det lokala religiösa samfundet.
example_en: He is an active member of the local religious community.

example_sv: Hon umgås i en intellektuell krets av konstnärer.
example_en: She socializes in an intellectual circle of artists.

example_en: The royal wedding was a big event for the country.

example_en: She will hold the position of CEO starting next month.

example_en: The country needs economic stability to develop.

example_sv: Han handlade i affekt och utan något förnuft alls.
example_en: He acted impulsively and without any reason at all.

example_en: He was tired, hence his lack of concentration.

example_en: You can ignore what he says, he is wrong.

example_en: She has an academic degree in literature.

example_sv: De söker en permanent lösning på problemet.
example_en: They are looking for a permanent solution to the problem.

example_sv: Den här boken är väldigt nyttig för mina studier.

example_sv: Hon älskar att vandra i den vilda naturen.
example_en: She loves to hike in the wild nature.

example_en: They spread propaganda to influence public opinion.

example_en: She is a believing Christian and goes to church every Sunday.

example_sv: Jag skulle vilja beställa ett exemplar av den nya boken.

example_sv: Det går ekonomiskt bra för företaget just nu.
example_en: The company is doing well economically right now.

example_en: He was run over and killed by a car on the crosswalk.

example_en: I can only agree with what you are saying.

example_sv: Jag kan försäkra dig om att allt kommer att bli bra.
example_en: I can assure you that everything will be alright.

example_sv: Hon har höga ideal om hur samhället borde vara.
example_en: She has high ideals about how society should be.
